source.author: samyakk
source.text:
I built Instinct internally for a product of ours 6 months back, and it got 2000 users within a couple weeks organically.

I am now open-sourcing the framework I used so anyone can launch Instinct like experiences on WhatsApp and iMessage.
source.title: Show HN: OSS framework to launch Instinct like iMessage assistants
